monetization_evidence.evidence: Threads post (dated 08/17/26 on the page) ends 'In collaboration with @artlist.io'. It promotes the Artlist Seedance 2.5 Challenge: 'Now it’s your turn to bring your own masterpiece to life. The @artlist.io Seedance 2.5 Challenge is live, and up to 25 creators will win up to $10,000 each! How to enter: • Create a 30s+ video using Seedance 2.5 on Artlist. ... • Tag @artlist.io by August 31st.' A Threads 'Paid partnership' label was NOT found in the page HTML; only the 'In collaboration with' wording was verified.

Threads post (dated 09/14/26, the same day as the 'If only you could dive into a masterpiece (Part 2: The Kiss)' post DdQ3Ym-iFK7): 'Creations like this are possible thanks to @artlist.io and its AI toolkit, which brings all the latest models together in one place: from creating images with Seedream 5.0 Pro to bringing them to life with Seedance 2.5... and making music with Lyria 3 Pro. In collaboration with @artlist.io'. This is a recurring Artlist sponsorship across at least 2 posts about 4 weeks apart.
The Linktree has an email button labelled 'CONTACT ME' (mailto:ifonlyia@gmail.com). The Linktree account is on a paid tier ('paid1'), was created 2024-01-02, per its public page JSON.

The Comptoir IA interview description (2025-04-10) says his visuals reached the community managers of big brands 'sans faire la moindre prospection': 'Il nous raconte comment ses visuels ont atteint les CM de Lamborghini, Valentino, LVMH… sans faire la moindre prospection.' This is a third-party podcast description. No actual deal with these brands was verified.

brand_deals_seen: Artlist (@artlist.io): 'In collaboration with @artlist.io', Threads posts DcJQg3jiHPD (08/17/26, Seedance 2.5 Challenge) and DdQ3fyLiFTt (09/14/26, AI toolkit plug)
content_mode_evidence: Explicit and self-declared. Bio: '🌀 Merge between Art and AI ⛵️ Prompts • #Midjourney'; TikTok bio: '🌀 AI artist | Original artworks'. Instagram reel C--Al6UA6GE is captioned 'If only 'home sweet home' meant living in a tiramisu house. Art/Prompts by @ifonly.ai & @sunt_mrr'. Threads post DdgjuopCPV1: 'Crafted using @midjourney & @dreamina_ai 🪽'. The Artlist posts name the models used (Seedream 5.0 Pro, Seedance 2.5, Lyria 3 Pro). The interview describes his workflow as 'Midjourney pour générer les images, Magnific AI pour l'upscaling, et Kling AI pour l'animation'.
niche_focus: Surreal 'If only…' AI concept art mixing architecture, food, fashion and fine art (e.g. a tiramisu house, stepping into Van Gogh / Klimt paintings, Seoul 'on pointed toes'). Interiors and houses are one theme among several, not the sole focus.
language: English captions; the creator is French and Paris-based (French-language Linktree/press items)
cta_pattern: Caption formula: 'If only …' hook (e.g. 'If only you could dive into a masterpiece (Part 2: The Kiss) 👇', 'If only Seoul could rise on pointed toes 🩰'). The multi-part series uses '👇' and 'If you missed Part 1...' links. Credit lines name tools and collaborators ('Art/Prompts by @ifonly.ai & @sunt_mrr', 'Crafted using @midjourney & @dreamina_ai'). Sponsored posts end with 'In collaboration with @artlist.io' and a participation CTA ('How to enter: ... Post publicly with #ArtlistSeedance25. Tag @artlist.io'). The link hub has a 'CONTACT ME' email.

notes: COVERAGE LIMITED. The WebSearch budget (200/200) was used up, so the step 1, 3 and 4 searches were not run. There are no Instagram snippets, the Instagram follower and post counts are UNKNOWN, and the reel sample is limited to the one reel captured on a public topic page. Cross-platform counts, platform-specific and not Instagram: Threads 77.4K followers and 365 threads; TikTok 94,600 followers, 8.9M likes, 264 videos (bioLink linktr.ee/ifonlyai); YouTube @IamIfOnly 536 subscribers, 73 videos. Self-reported reach: Threads post DdrOUBhCLzd (about 1 day before collection) says 'Someone told me Trial Reels were dead. I posted this one yesterday: 20M views in 24hrs.' This is the creator's own claim; the reel was not identified. Reel C--Al6UA6GE had 136M views on the public topic page (rounded, posted 2024-08-22) and is a collaboration credited to @ifonly.ai & @sunt_mrr (see profile_sunt_mrr.json). The Threads post codes above (Dd…/Dc…) are THREADS posts and are deliberately NOT in reel_sample. Despite 'Prompts' in the bio, no paid prompt pack, course, shop or storefront was found on the Linktree. The only commercial items are the email contact and the Artlist collaborations. Tool mentions (Midjourney, Dreamina, Magnific AI, Kling AI) are credits, and their paid status is UNKNOWN. The owner's first name 'Vincent' appears on his own Linktree and YouTube; no further personal data was collected. No income estimate was seen or made.
